translations.text: Let us glorify the Lord of hosts with holy songs, the guardian of the kingdom of heaven; let us love him lovingly, the possessor of life. And to him always be victorious glory above with the angels, and on earth peace to every man of good will.
We praise you with holy voices and bless you, gracious Father, and we thank you, ruler of peoples, for your worthy, glorious joy and for the great mysteries of your powers,
in that you, Lord God, by the powers of the Spirit hold heaven and earth in your control, one eternal Father, almighty God.
You are King of kings over every living being; you are the victorious Son and true Saviour over all creation, of angels and of men.
You, Lord God, dwell in joys in the noble city on high, lord of every people, just as in the beginning you were a Son equally blessed with your own Father.
You are the heavenly light and the holy Lamb, who in your mercy cast down all the sinful guilt of the world, put the fiend to flight, saved the people, and bought the children of Israel with blood,

when through the holy tree of your passion you lifted away the darkness of sins, so that you sit triumphant on the high throne of the kingdom of heaven at the right hand of God your Father, mindful of souls.
Have mercy now, mighty one, on mankind, and release your beloved creation from sins, and make us whole, creator of men, saviour of men, for the honour of your name.
Truly you are always holy, and you alone are the eternal Lord, and you alone are judge of all, of the living and the dead, Christ the Saviour,
for you reign in majesty, in Trinity and in unity, ruler of all, high King of the heavens, beautifully filled with the Holy Spirit in the glory of the Father.
